visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black oversized T-shirt and black shorts, stands in front of a gray industrial building with a large '九葉國際' sign. He holds a black pressure washer gun connected to a gray portable base unit on wheels. The ground is light gray concrete, and a dirty black Tesla is parked beside him. (2) Close-up on the gray base unit, which looks like a rectangular, foldable bucket with black handles. A text overlay 'T-PRO 2.0' identifies the product. The man's hands are visible holding the handles to lift the lightweight device, demonstrating its portability in a bright outdoor setting. (3) The man points to the base of the washing unit, emphasizing that it is not plugged into a wall outlet. He wears black sneakers and black socks. The black Tesla behind him shows significant dirt streaks and dried mud on its side panels and wheels. (4) Close-up of a car wheel with distinct red brake calipers. A powerful stream of water from the nozzle hits the muddy tire and rim, instantly washing away the grime. The water creates a fine white mist and splashes against the dark pavement. (5) An informative graphic appears on screen, showing five circular icons for different spray patterns: 10°, 20°, 20° tilted, 40°, and a shower mode. Each is accompanied by Traditional Chinese text explaining specific cleaning tasks like tire washing or balcony rinsing. (6) On the black car's trunk, a single white bird dropping is targeted. The man uses a focused, high-pressure spray. The blast removes the stain immediately, leaving a clean, wet surface. A small white sparkle animation is edited in to highlight the cleanliness. (7) The man attaches a clear plastic bottle filled with green cleaning solution to the nozzle. He sprays a layer of thick white foam onto the rear and side of the Tesla. The foam clings to the car body, completely obscuring the black paint and 'TESLA' badge. (8) A fast-cut montage shows the man scrubbing the foam with a black circular sponge. He then rinses the car with the pressure washer again. The car now has a glossy, reflective finish. The background showroom displays high-end sports cars like Porsches. (9) The man stands under a wooden porch as rain begins to fall. He looks up at the gray, overcast sky with a resigned expression. He crouches to wipe moisture off the gray T-PRO base unit with purple microfiber towels. (10) The scene shifts to a sunny outdoor park with green trees and a paved path. The man demonstrates the 'shower' mode by watering the grass and bushes. Large yellow text overlays appear, listing the product price and a discount code.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity over an upbeat electronic BGM track. The BGM features a steady synth pulse and a bright melody. The acoustic environment is an outdoor street with a light ambient noise floor. (2) As the man explains the pressure washer's features, the low, steady hum of a motor becomes audible. The speaker's pitch rises slightly during the introduction of the 'T-PRO 2.0'. (3) A loud, broadband 'shushing' sound of high-pressure water hitting metal and rubber dominates the mix. The motor hum persists underneath the splashing water sounds. The BGM maintains its tempo. (4) Multiple sharp, metallic clicks are heard as the nozzle head is manually rotated to change modes. A clear, synthesized 'ding' sound effect marks a successful cleaning moment. (5) The sound texture shifts to a softer, more aerated spray as foam is applied to the car. The man's voice remains dominant and upbeat. (6) A high-pitched, fast-paced whirring sound effect is added during the scrub montage to indicate speed-up editing. The BGM remains at a consistent volume. (7) The acoustic atmosphere changes as the man stops the device. The faint, soft patter of rain on a roof or car is audible. His vocal tone shifts to a more conversational, ironic pitch. (8) The scene transition to a park introduces natural ambient sounds like distant bird calls. The water spray sound returns in a diffused 'shower' pattern. The man concludes with a clear call to action over the fading BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Feature Demo -> Use Case Variety -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional review of the T-PRO 2.0 wireless high-pressure washer. It uses a humorous 'accidental rain' hook to demonstrate the product's effectiveness and portability on both cars and garden plants.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of price, discount code 'JM100', and a call to check the link in the IG bio.
